presentation.summary: Choose and verify noise controls when production conditions and exposure patterns change.
presentation.situation: A production line has become noticeably louder after equipment changes. Workers rotate between several noisy stations during the shift.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A production line has become noticeably louder after equipment changes. Workers rotate between several noisy stations during the shift.

work_authorization_record.title: Noise Change Assessment
work_authorization_record.summary: The line is louder after modification, while the existing survey describes the earlier equipment condition.
details: The previous survey was completed before the equipment change.
Workers now report a noticeable increase in sound during normal production.
A current assessment should reflect the modified line and actual time spent at each station.

control_verification_record.title: Noise Measurement and Control Check
control_verification_record.summary: Measurements confirm elevated noise near one machine while employees rotate through the area.
details: Worker exposure depends on both sound level and time spent near the machine.
Rotation changes exposure duration but does not remove the need to control the noisy source.
The existing control arrangement should be reviewed against the measured condition before normal work continues.

condition_change_record.title: Exposure Duration Change Record
condition_change_record.summary: Higher production has increased the time workers spend at the loudest station.
details: The current work pattern differs from the duration used during the earlier assessment.
Longer time at the loudest station can increase total daily noise exposure.
The revised staffing and production pattern should be included in the updated assessment.

response_record.title: Enclosure Defect Record
response_record.summary: A noise-control enclosure door is open and damaged during production.
details: The damaged door reduces the effectiveness of the enclosure as an engineering control.
Noise levels with the enclosure impaired may differ from the previously verified condition.
The defect remains a control failure until the enclosure is repaired and its performance checked.

closeout_record.title: Closeout Record
closeout_record.summary: Review the verified record before making the next decision.
details: Use the record to confirm the current work boundary and control status.

prejob_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: A partial control is not equivalent to completing every prerequisite.

prejob_decision_best.observable: The work remains controlled and the next stage is approached with the required safeguards verified.
prejob_decision_best.guidedInsight: Verify the complete control sequence before work continues.

prejob_decision_weak.observable: The control gap increases exposure and weakens the work position.
prejob_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Schedule pressure should not replace verification.

prejob_decision_critical.observable: The decision creates a serious loss of control.
prejob_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Do not substitute assumptions for verified control.

safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
